context_requirements: Active cell cycle progression through mitosis; quiescent or postmitotic cells show little response
Expression of KIF11 (Eg5) and an intact mitotic spindle assembly/checkpoint machinery
Proliferating cells with functional spindle assembly checkpoint for maximal mitotic arrest
Apoptosis competence for late cytotoxic transcriptional consequences
falsifiers: No increase in mitotic/spindle checkpoint transcripts (e.g., BUB1B, CCNB1, CDC20, PLK1, UBE2C) at 6 h in any responsive line
No G2/M arrest or proliferation-down signature at 24 h
Strong transcriptional response in non-proliferating or postmitotic cells
Response pattern indistinguishable from microtubule poisons (e.g., no distinct KIF11-dependent mitotic arrest signature)
No late apoptosis or p53-target induction despite sustained mitotic arrest

evidence.supports: KSP/KIF11 inhibitor CK0106023 causes mitotic arrest and growth inhibition in human tumor cell lines
Kif11 inhibitor ispinesib resistance in glioblastoma is driven by suppression of apoptosis via STAT3 activation
Eg5 kinesin inhibitor cytotoxicity is proliferation-dependent and higher in spindle checkpoint-proficient cells
Mitotic spindle assembly defects and checkpoint activation lead to preanaphase arrest and apoptosis
